description: Needs student-ok (confirm:true OR elicitation) after the student asked to see their Private Notes, because notes are personal text. Lists the first page of the student's own Private Notes: text (untrusted, capped), the date ADAM shows, and the title and ref_id of the object each note is on when ADAM shows one. Read-only: never creates, edits, deletes, exports or sorts notes, and never reads public comments. Follow nextCursor. evidence is "lab-verified": parsed from ILIAS 10.12 lab markup with seeded notes; it fails closed (provider_unavailable) when ADAM markup differs. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"confirm":true}.

confirm.description: Optional gate. Set true only after the student asked to see their ADAM Private Notes. Notes are personal text and untrusted. Confirm contract: pass confirm:true OR approve elicitation; hosts without elicitation require confirm:true; decline/cancel → same confirmation_required, no data; forum needs gate only with threadId. Recipe: {"confirm":true}.

cursor.description: Opaque decimal token — copy nextCursor verbatim into cursor, do not invent offsets. Expired browser cursors require restarting the listing without cursor.

refresh.description: Re-read the notes overview from ADAM; omit cursor when true
